title: Flare
summary: A team project that helps local communities explore fragmented wildfire information in one place. It combines a map, risk indicators, related news, a wildfire-focused AI chatbot, and web push notifications in an installable web application.

keyOutcome.label: Key Outcome
keyOutcome.value: Combined maps, risk indicators, news, questions, and alerts in one PWA
keyOutcome.description: The evidence is the implemented user flow and web and installed-environment demos rather than an unverified metric.

projectIntro.title: Project overview
projectIntro.description: I designed a map-centered exploration flow that connects wildfire locations and risk levels with related news, follow-up questions, and alerts. The interface includes news collected through the Bing News API and a web crawler, a wildfire-focused chatbot built with the OpenAI API, Firebase web push, and installation flows for mobile and desktop browsers.

product.label: Product
product.description: An installable web application for exploring wildfire information and related questions

users.label: Users
users.description: Local users who want to review wildfire locations, risk indicators, and related news in one place

role.label: My scope
role.description: Designed and implemented major full-stack features including PWA installation, a wildfire-focused AI chatbot, and web push notifications

informationFlow.title: Unified fragmented wildfire information around a map-first flow
informationFlow.description: I helped bring information from separate sources into one view where users could understand the situation and continue with follow-up questions.

fragmentedInformation.title: Information spread across separate channels
fragmentedInformation.description: Wildfire locations, risk indicators, and related news were separated, leaving users to assemble the current situation themselves.

unifiedView.title: A map-centered unified view
unifiedView.description: Wildfire locations and risk levels were placed on the map, with related news available in the same exploration flow.

installableWeb.title: An installable web path
installableWeb.description: PWA installation and web push notifications supported repeat access on mobile and desktop without a separate native application.

consolidatedAccess.title: One exploration flow
consolidatedAccess.description: Users could move through the map, risk indicators, news, wildfire questions, and notifications in one web application.

walkthrough.title: Product walkthrough
walkthrough.description: The videos demonstrate the implemented screens and user flows in the web and installed experiences.
